people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
translations.bsb: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria. My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
translations.kjv: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
translations.asv: He hath cast off thy calf, O Samaria; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
